speaker: kai_patel
headline: YOU CANNOT REPAIR WHAT THE SYSTEM CANNOT SEE.
deck: Monitoring turns infrastructure from a black box into a continuously observable operating state.
quote: The key question is not whether a dashboard exists. It is whether the right signal reaches the right response in time.
facts: Telemetry should expose state changes before users report failure.
Alerts need thresholds tied to action, not decorative dashboards.
Operators need a shared view of incidents and recovery.
Verification prevents a closed ticket from masquerading as a solved problem.
takeaway: Observability is infrastructure: it shortens the distance between failure, diagnosis and repair.
